name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio:
Rhys discovered his passion for motorsport through a childhood fascination with racing games, which eventually led him to explore the complex IT infrastructure underpinning modern racing teams. He holds a degree in Computer Science from Cardiff University. Before joining Hitech Development, Rhys worked for a large software firm, where he honed his skills in network security and data management, skills he felt were applicable to the high-pressure world of motorsport.

At Hitech, Rhys is responsible for ensuring the team's IT systems are secure, reliable, and cutting-edge. He has a keen interest in data analytics and believes that extracting meaningful insights from the vast amounts of data generated during races is crucial for gaining a competitive edge. His methodical approach, combined with his visionary ideas, allows him to balance day-to-day operational needs with long-term strategic planning. Rhys distinguishes himself with his ability to explain complex technical issues in a clear and concise manner, fostering effective communication between the IT department and other team members.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Rhys is of average height with a slightly athletic build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with diagrams and code snippets.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on using a mechanical keyboard with extremely clicky keys.
